services.name: Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: Looking for a Cape Cod fishing excursion? Look no further than a Hy-Line Deep Sea Fishing trip! Cruise out into Nantucket Sound and you’ll bottom fish (sometimes called deep sea fishing) for scup, fluke, black seabass and tautog. Bait is included in the price and rod rentals are available for a nominal fee (free on the 2.5-hour trips). The deckhands will assist you and help with baiting the hook, sometimes tangled lines, and, for a nominal fee, will happily fillet and bag your catch of the day. Hy-Line Fishing is a fun addition to your day in Hyannis, whether out with the guys or the kids or grandkids! services.name: Sunset Swiftie
services.desc: It’s time to enter your Canal Cruise Era! ✨ Enjoy stunning sunset views of the Cape Cod Canal (weather permitting) and a two-hour Taylor Swift themed playlist. Dance and sing along to your favorite anthems as you glide through the historic Cape Cod Canal. Sing along to your favorite songs from every era as you enjoy a cruise through the picturesque Cape Cod Canal. Taylor may be known for her iconic musical bridges, but we have a few iconic bridges of our own - the Bourne and the Sagamore. blurb: Hy-Line Cruises operates high-speed passenger ferries and local cruises including Cape Cod Canal Cruises. They provide seasonal and year-round ferry services to Nantucket and Martha's Vineyard, as well as inter-island ferry service. Amenities include indoor and outdoor seating, snack bars, and pet-friendly policies on most ferries.
